set.body:
Source: review of public API documentation and examples.

Problem:
semantics such as evidence authority, freshness, cancellation uncertainty, attempt epochs, environment policy, and resource ownership live mostly in tests; public Scaladoc is sparse.

Acceptance:
- Add Scaladoc for public algebras, ADTs, opaque types, resources, authority/freshness rules, and cancellation/acceptance uncertainty.
- Add concise quickstarts for local CLI, SSH agent, managed durable control, resumable logs, opaque outputs, and typed tasks using the published facades.
- State resource ownership, limits, security assumptions, compatibility, and non-goals at the point of use.
- Compile documentation snippets on Scala 3.7.4 and keep deeper architecture links available without requiring them for first use.
set.title: P6f.20: Document public contracts and five-line quickstarts
